answer.evidence: The wall is a flat, front-facing white panel with a framed painting (rows 7-23 in the scan) and a grey baseboard (rows 28-29). The silhouette is 44 px wide on every row from 0 to 30, so there is no step, roof slope or ellipse. Rows 1-5 form a thin cornice-like strip of beige, white and cream, closed by one dark line at row 6. It has no lighter or darker front-edge line of its own and no eave shadow, and it reads as a front-facing molding, not a horizontal top surface. No top plane is visible, so this matches the red 'front elevation' references, not the green three-quarter ones.
